independent_reviser_checks.title: Optimized temporal binning of comparison star measurements for differential photometry
independent_reviser_checks.locator: Publisher article payload: §2.5, §3.2, Discussion, and Conclusions
independent_reviser_checks.access_time_note: Clock read immediately before the web open/search batch; page-specific successful-fetch time was not exposed. Direct open returned a 500 redirect to an inaccessible OUP minimal page. The exact-title search returned the official Oxford Academic article payload.
independent_reviser_checks.observed_operation: Read the official publisher payload. It states that the method assumes good photometric conditions, no high-frequency systematic trends, and no blending; the pipeline says to skip binning during high-frequency-trend periods; the discussion says binning can remain beneficial outside occasional rapid-trend intervals.
independent_reviser_checks.governing_condition_default_exception: Use only when systematics are predominantly low-frequency relative to cadence and the data are otherwise suitable. Do not bin intervals with high-frequency trends; occasional such intervals do not require abandoning the method for all other intervals. The paper's demonstrated cadence and conditions do not establish benefit for this archive.
independent_reviser_checks.applicability_transferability: Supports amending the draft's blanket-sounding caveat to an interval-specific optional method. Does not establish the local cadence, weather, or benefit.
